description:
Rank both YES and NO across every human-reviewed equivalent Polymarket–Kalshi
    pair. Each row walks current public depth within the all-in budget, includes
    estimated taker fees, and links to the lower effective-price venue. Contracts
    whose rules changed or whose requested size cannot be quoted are omitted and
    reported as unavailable. Optional `family` uses a family key returned by the tool;
    optional `side` is Yes or No. Use this when the user asks where the largest
    currently executable cross-venue price differences are. This answers 'where is it cheaper to buy one side'; for buying opposite sides on both venues for a covered payout use list_arbitrage_candidates.

amount_usd.description: All-in budget in USD, estimated taker fees included
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

family.description: Optional market family key returned by this tool, e.g. 'democratic_nominee_2028'
family.title: Family

side.description: Optional 'Yes' or 'No' to restrict the side
side.title: Side

name: list_executable_opportunities
